comparisons.peer_topic: Employee Culture and Engagement Survey Results
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD conducts annual global workforce surveys to measure culture and engagement; the 2024 survey results were among the best for global tech companies, with employees describing the culture as inclusive and innovative and engagement ratings in the top 10% of peers.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD identify human capital culture and engagement as strategic priorities, but Intel focuses on the general necessity of talent for strategy execution while AMD provides specific survey-based validation of its culture. Intel states that attracting and retaining top talent is central to delivering its strategy and growth ambitions. In contrast, AMD quantifies its success by reporting that its 2024 engagement ratings are in the top 10% of peers and that employees describe the culture as inclusive and innovative.

sentences.text: Delivering on our strategy and growth ambitions requires attracting, developing, and retaining top talent from across the world.
Our people build our technology, unlock new business opportunities, and work with our partners and customers to create global impact.
Results from our 2024 survey reported scores that continued to be among the very best for global companies in the technology industry.

Our employees described our culture as inclusive, innovative, open, and respectful, and rated the quality of our managers high, and employment engagement is among the top 10% of our high-performing technology industry peers.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA has grown its technical workforce, which comprises 83% technical employees, 49% holding advanced degrees, with over 40% of new hires in fiscal year 2024 originating from employee referrals.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and NVIDIA highlight the competitiveness of the global technical labor market and their success in attracting high-caliber technical talent. Intel notes that its people build technology and create global impact, implying successful recruitment of skilled personnel. NVIDIA provides specific metrics on this success, stating that 83% of its workforce is technical, nearly half hold advanced degrees, and it has been successful in attracting top talent globally through its employer brand.
